profile.headline: Junior Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: As a new junior full stack developer, I bring a fresh perspective and enthusiasm for learning and growing within the tech industry. With a keen interest in honing my skills and expanding my knowledge base, I am committed to evolving into a proficient and versatile developer. Whether it's managing projects or writing code, I am adept at maintaining structure and clarity throughout the process. Collaboration is at the heart of my approach to work. Drawing from a rich history of teamwork, I value the diverse perspectives and ideas that arise from collective effort. I find great fulfillment in engaging with fellow developers, sharing insights, and collectively overcoming obstacles to achieve our goals. I am driven by a deep-seated curiosity for knowledge.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Huntington, West Virginia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Intensive full-time 6-month software development immersive training program focusing on full stack (C#/.NET) development fundamentals and problem solving. The final half of the program is executed in a simulated company environment with Scum methodology.
• Applied object-oriented programming fundamentals through team-based projects that reflect real-world business problems.
• Collaborated remotely on projects using Slack and Zoom.
• Managed source code version control with Git/ GitHub.
• Applied JavaScript, HTML, and CSS fundamentals to build a feature-rich social media dashboard.
• Leveraged native ES6 module bundling to build DRY, reusable components.
• Designed and built a single-page kennel management application with React using Hooks.
• Designed applications through whiteboarding dependencies and building ERD's (Entity-Relationship Diagrams).
• Created a C#/.NETCore RESTful API to track resources at an e-commerce company.
• Built and maintained integration tests for APIs in ASP.NET Core.
• Developed an HR tracking app and an e-commerce platform using ASP.NET, MVC, and Razor templates in Visual Studio 2019.

projects.title: Coral Island Companion
projects.description: I built an app to make playing the indie game Coral Island a more enjoyable experience. It allows users to store and keep track of in game events and reminders as well as personal tasks that need to be completed. The app also gives you the resources to stay in touch with the game's festivals and characters.
